rows.role_title: President of the Republic of South Africa
rows.text: The Table Division's record says that on 14 February the President, Mr J G Zuma, addressed the nation on national television and announced his resignation, then communicated it to the Speaker, indicating that it was effective immediately (citing the ATC of 15 February 2018, p. 3).

locator.item: [1] Resignation of President and election of new President, first paragraph

rows.role_title: President of the Republic of South Africa
rows.text: The same record states that Mr Zuma tendered his resignation as President of the Republic on 14 February with immediate effect, and that the following day Mr M C Ramaphosa was elected President of the Republic.

locator.item: [7] Postponement of State of the Nation Address

rows.role_title: President of the Republic of South Africa
rows.text: The same item [1] records that on 15 February Mr M C Ramaphosa, the only nominee, was elected President of the Republic, and that 'The President-elect was sworn in later that afternoon at a separate ceremony at Tuynhuys, the Cape Town office of the Presidency'.

locator.item: [1], final paragraph ('The President-elect was sworn in later that afternoon')
